<?php
// Mobile Backend API - Certificate Pinning & Mutual TLS Handler
// Handles async webhook delivery with certificate validation

namespace App\Security;

use React\Promise\PromiseInterface;
use React\EventLoop\LoopInterface;

class CertificateChainValidator
{
    private array $trustedRoots;
    private array $pinnedFingerprints;
    private int $maxChainDepth;
    private bool $enforceRevocation;
    
    const HASH_ALGORITHM = 'sha256';
    const FINGERPRINT_ENCODING = 'base64';
    
    public function __construct(array $config)
    {
        $this->trustedRoots = $config['trusted_roots'] ?? [];
        $this->pinnedFingerprints = $config['pinned_fingerprints'] ?? [];
        $this->maxChainDepth = $config['max_chain_depth'] ?? 5;
        $this->enforceRevocation = $config['enforce_revocation'] ?? true;
    }
    
    public function validateCertificateChain(array $chain, string $expectedHost): PromiseInterface
    {
        return \React\Async\async(function () use ($chain, $expectedHost) {
            if (empty($chain)) {
                throw new CertificateValidationException('Empty certificate chain');
            }
            
            if (count($chain) > $this->maxChainDepth) {
                throw new CertificateValidationException('Chain exceeds maximum depth');
            }
            
            $leafCert = $chain[0];
            
            // Step 1: Validate leaf certificate hostname
            $hostValid = $this->verifyHostname($leafCert, $expectedHost);
            if (!$hostValid) {
                throw new CertificateValidationException('Hostname mismatch');
            }
            
            // Step 2: Check certificate dates
            $dateValid = $this->verifyDates($leafCert);
            if (!$dateValid) {
                throw new CertificateValidationException('Certificate expired or not yet valid');
            }
            
            // Step 3: Verify chain signatures (async for OCSP)
            $chainValid = \React\Async\await($this->verifyChainSignatures($chain));
            if (!$chainValid) {
                throw new CertificateValidationException('Chain signature verification failed');
            }
            
            // Step 4: Check pin against known fingerprints
            $pinValid = $this->verifyPin($leafCert);
            if (!$pinValid) {
                throw new CertificateValidationException('Certificate pin mismatch');
            }
            
            // Step 5: OCSP/CRL revocation check
            if ($this->enforceRevocation) {
                $revocationStatus = \React\Async\await($this->checkRevocation($leafCert));
                if ($revocationStatus->isRevoked()) {
                    throw new CertificateValidationException('Certificate has been revoked');
                }
            }
            
            return new ValidationResult(true, $leafCert);
        })();
    }
    
    private function verifyHostname($cert, string $expectedHost): bool
    {
        $certData = openssl_x509_parse($cert);
        if (!$certData) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Check Subject Alternative Names first
        $sans = $certData['extensions']['subjectAltName'] ?? '';
        $sanEntries = array_map('trim', explode(',', $sans));
        
        foreach ($sanEntries as $san) {
            if (strpos($san, 'DNS:') === 0) {
                $dnsName = substr($san, 4);
                if ($this->matchHostname($dnsName, $expectedHost)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Fallback to CN
        $cn = $certData['subject']['CN'] ?? '';
        return $this->matchHostname($cn, $expectedHost);
    }
    
    private function matchHostname(string $pattern, string $hostname): bool
    {
        $pattern = strtolower($pattern);
        $hostname = strtolower($hostname);
        
        if ($pattern === $hostname) {
            return true;
        }
        
        // Wildcard matching - only allow single level
        if (strpos($pattern, '*.') === 0) {
            $patternSuffix = substr($pattern, 2);
            $hostParts = explode('.', $hostname, 2);
            if (count($hostParts) === 2 && $hostParts[1] === $patternSuffix) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        
        return false;
    }
    
    private function verifyDates($cert): bool
    {
        $certData = openssl_x509_parse($cert);
        if (!$certData) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $now = time();
        $validFrom = $certData['validFrom_time_t'];
        $validTo = $certData['validTo_time_t'];
        
        return ($now >= $validFrom && $now <= $validTo);
    }
    
    private function verifyChainSignatures(array $chain): PromiseInterface
    {
        return \React\Async\async(function () use ($chain) {
            for ($i = 0; $i < count($chain) - 1; $i++) {
                $issued = $chain[$i];
                $issuer = $chain[$i + 1];
                
                if (!openssl_x509_verify($issued, openssl_pkey_get_public($issuer))) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            
            // Verify root against trusted store
            $rootCert = end($chain);
            $rootFingerprint = $this->computeFingerprint($rootCert);
            
            return in_array($rootFingerprint, $this->trustedRoots);
        })();
    }
    
    private function verifyPin($cert): bool
    {
        if (empty($this->pinnedFingerprints)) {
            // No pins configured - skip pin validation
            return true;
        }
        
        $certFingerprint = $this->computeFingerprint($cert);
        $pinMatched = false;
        
        foreach ($this->pinnedFingerprints as $pin) {
            if ($this->constantTimeCompare($certFingerprint, $pin)) {
                $pinMatched = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        
        return $pinMatched;
    }
    
    private function computeFingerprint($cert): string
    {
        $pubKey = openssl_pkey_get_public($cert);
        $pubKeyDetails = openssl_pkey_get_details($pubKey);
        $derEncoded = $pubKeyDetails['key'];
        
        $hash = hash(self::HASH_ALGORITHM, $derEncoded, true);
        return base64_encode($hash);
    }
    
    private function constantTimeCompare(string $a, string $b): bool
    {
        if (strlen($a) !== strlen($b)) {
            return false;
        }
        return hash_equals($a, $b);
    }
    
    private function checkRevocation($cert): PromiseInterface
    {
        return \React\Async\async(function () use ($cert) {
            // Async OCSP stapling check
            $ocspUrl = $this->extractOCSPUrl($cert);
            if ($ocspUrl) {
                return \React\Async\await($this->queryOCSP($ocspUrl, $cert));
            }
            return new RevocationStatus(false);
        })();
    }
    
    private function extractOCSPUrl($cert): ?string
    {
        $certData = openssl_x509_parse($cert);
        $aia = $certData['extensions']['authorityInfoAccess'] ?? '';
        if (preg_match('/OCSP\s*-\s*URI:(.+?)(?:\n|$)/i', $aia, $matches)) {
            return trim($matches[1]);
        }
        return null;
    }
    
    private function queryOCSP(string $url, $cert): PromiseInterface
    {
        return \React\Async\async(function () use ($url, $cert) {
            // Simulated async OCSP query
            return new RevocationStatus(false);
        })();
    }
}

class MobileAPIGateway
{
    private CertificateChainValidator $validator;
    private array $clientCertCache = [];
    
    public function __construct(CertificateChainValidator $validator)
    {
        $this->validator = $validator;
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(array $request): PromiseInterface
    {
        return \React\Async\async(function () use ($request) {
            $clientCert = $request['client_certificate'] ?? null;
            $clientChain = $request['certificate_chain'] ?? [];
            $targetHost = $request['target_host'] ?? '';
            
            if (!$clientCert) {
                return $this->errorResponse(401, 'Client certificate required');
            }
            
            // Check cache for previously validated certs
            $cacheKey = $this->getCacheKey($clientCert);
            $cachedResult = $this->getCachedValidation($cacheKey);
            
            if ($cachedResult !== null) {
                if ($cachedResult->isValid()) {
                    return $this->processAuthenticatedRequest($request);
                }
                return $this->errorResponse(403, 'Certificate validation failed (cached)');
            }
            
            // Perform full validation
            try {
                $fullChain = array_merge([$clientCert], $clientChain);
                $result = \React\Async\await(
                    $this->validator->validateCertificateChain($fullChain, $targetHost)
                );
                
                $this->cacheValidation($cacheKey, $result);
                return $this->processAuthenticatedRequest($request);
            } catch (CertificateValidationException $e) {
                $this->cacheValidation($cacheKey, new ValidationResult(false, null));
                return $this->errorResponse(403, $e->getMessage());
            }
        })();
    }
    
    private function getCacheKey($cert): string
    {
        return hash('sha256', openssl_x509_fingerprint($cert, 'sha256'));
    }
    
    private function getCachedValidation(string $key): ?ValidationResult
    {
        return $this->clientCertCache[$key] ?? null;
    }
    
    private function cacheValidation(string $key, ValidationResult $result): void
    {
        $this->clientCertCache[$key] = $result;
    }
    
    private function processAuthenticatedRequest(array $request): array
    {
        return ['status' => 200, 'body' => 'Authenticated successfully'];
    }
    
    private function errorResponse(int $code, string $message): array
    {
        return ['status' => $code, 'body' => $message];
    }
}

class ValidationResult
{
    private bool $valid;
    private $certificate;
    
    public function __construct(bool $valid, $certificate)
    {
        $this->valid = $valid;
        $this->certificate = $certificate;
    }
    
    public function isValid(): bool
    {
        return $this->valid;
    }
}

class RevocationStatus
{
    private bool $revoked;
    
    public function __construct(bool $revoked)
    {
        $this->revoked = $revoked;
    }
    
    public function isRevoked(): bool
    {
        return $this->revoked;
    }
}

class CertificateValidationException extends \Exception {}
